summary: Refresh an application access token by POSTing grant_type=refresh_token and the refresh_token to http://<gateway>/o/token/ with basic auth <client_id>:<client_secret> of the related application. The /o/* endpoints accept only x-www-form-urlencoded, not application/json.
questions: How do I refresh an AAP access token with curl?
What content type do AAP OAuth endpoints require?

answer_card.title: Refresh an access token
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -d "grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=<refresh_token>" \
  -u "<client_id>:<client_secret>" \
  http://<gateway>/o/token/ -i
```
Use the client ID and secret of the token's application. `/o/*` endpoints accept only `x-www-form-urlencoded`, not JSON.
